class.name: NNSTTickedNodes
class.brief_description: Base class for active states ticked by an [NNSTRoot] ([NNSTNode] and [NNSTParallel]).
class.description: Provides state lifecycle hooks ([method on_enter_condition], [method on_enter_state], [method on_tick], and [method on_exit_state]), matching signals, utility scoring, and [method transition_to]. A state can also host child AI roots ([NNBTRoot], [NNSTRoot], [NNHTNRoot], or [NNAgent]). Hosted roots run while the state is active and automatically send [member hosted_success_event] or [member hosted_failure_event] to the chart when they finish, letting [NNSTTransition] nodes react without extra script code.

method.name: get_activation_generation
method.description: Returns a counter that increments each time this state is entered, useful for distinguishing separate activations of the same state.

method.name: get_on_entered_condition
method.description: Returns the fallback enter-condition result used when [method on_enter_condition] is not overridden.

method.name: get_root
method.description: Returns the owning [NNSTRoot] for this state, or [code]null[/code] if not inside a state tree.

method.name: on_enter_condition
method.description: Override to decide whether this state may be entered. If not overridden, emits [signal state_check_enter_condition] and uses [method get_on_entered_condition] (default [code]true[/code]).

method.name: on_enter_state
method.description: Override to initialize the state when entered (runs before [signal state_entered]).

method.name: on_exit_state
method.description: Override to clean up when leaving the state (runs before [signal state_exited]).

method.name: on_tick
method.description: Override to run per-tick logic while this state is active (runs before [signal state_ticked]).

method.name: set_on_entered_condition
method.description: Sets the enter-condition result from a [signal state_check_enter_condition] handler when [method on_enter_condition] is not overridden.

method.name: transition_to
method.description: Transitions directly to the state or [NNSTHistory] node at [param new_state_nodepath] (relative to this node). Returns [code]true[/code] if applied, or [code]false[/code] if the target is invalid.

members.member: How child [NNConsiderations] scores are combined into [member score]. Defaults to [constant NoodleNodes.EVALUATION_MULTIPLY].
Event sent to the state tree when a hosted child root finishes with failure. Leave empty to send nothing.
Event sent to the state tree when a hosted child root finishes with success. Leave empty to send nothing.
If [code]true[/code], entering this state emits [signal NNSTRoot.finished] to signal that the state tree has reached a terminal state (useful when this state tree is hosted by another AI system).
Most recently computed utility score from child considerations (used when the parent selects children with [code]UtilityScoring[/code]).

signal.name: event_received
signal.description: Emitted when an event sent with [method NNSTBranchNodes.send_event] reaches this state.

signal.name: hosted_root_finished
signal.description: Emitted when a hosted child root finishes its run.

signal.name: state_check_enter_condition
signal.description: Emitted before entering if [method on_enter_condition] is not overridden. Call [method set_on_entered_condition] in the handler to allow or deny entry.

signal.name: state_entered
signal.description: Emitted when the state is entered.

signal.name: state_exited
signal.description: Emitted when the state is exited.

signal.name: state_ticked
signal.description: Emitted on each tick while the state is active.

signal.name: transition_pending
signal.description: Emitted each tick while a delayed [NNSTTransition] from this state is counting down.
